s.favorite_count DESC, s.create_time DESC, s.id DESC s.view_count DESC, s.create_time DESC, s.id DESC s.create_time DESC, s.id DESC

SELECT FROM guitar_sheet s INNER JOIN guitar_user u ON u.id = s.uploader_id WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE guitar_sheet SET view_count = view_count + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guitar_daily_stat (stat_date, new_user_count, uploaded_sheet_count, sheet_view_count, favorite_count, offline_sheet_count) VALUES (#{statDate}, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sheet_view_count = sheet_view_count + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT FROM guitar_sheet s INNER JOIN guitar_user u ON u.id = s.uploader_id WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.uploader_id = #{ownerId} AND s.status != 'DELETED' AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM guitar_sheet s INNER JOIN guitar_user u ON u.id = s.uploader_id WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.uploader_id = #{ownerId} AND s.status != 'DELETED' AND s.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM guitar_sheet WHERE id = #{id} AND status != 'DELETED' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE guitar_sheet SET song_name=#{sheet.songName}, singer=#{sheet.singer}, arranger=#{sheet.arranger}, description=#{sheet.description}, keywords=#{sheet.keywords}, sheet_type=#{sheet.sheetType}, difficulty=#{sheet.difficulty}, key_signature=#{sheet.keySignature}, capo_position=#{sheet.capoPosition}, tuning=#{sheet.tuning}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{sheet.id} AND uploader_id=#{sheet.uploaderId} AND status != 'DELETED' AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE guitar_sheet SET file_mode=#{sheet.fileMode}, storage_uuid=#{sheet.storageUuid}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{sheet.id} AND uploader_id=#{sheet.uploaderId} AND status != 'DELETED' AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE guitar_sheet SET status='DELETED', deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, favorite_count=0, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND uploader_id=#{ownerId} AND status != 'DELETED' AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE guitar_sheet SET favorite_count=0, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='DELETED'
